text: I've been receiving treatment at Dr. Hongrat's clinic for a long time. The doctor is lovely, and provides excellent treatment, consultations, and advice. The clinic staff are also very polite and provide great service. If you're looking for a skilled obstetrician's clinic in Phuket, I highly recommend Dr. Hongrat's. You won't be disappointed!
The doctor provided excellent service; they treated me like family. The service at the reception counter was also outstanding.
